_comment: Font presets for the .s2df font maker. params = the real FreeTypeFontParameter fields the engine applies (size, color, border*, shadow*, space*, pad*, hinting, mono, kerning, gamma, renderCount, min/magFilter). Colors are RRGGBBAA. Shadow offset: positive X = right, positive Y = down.

presets.name: Arcade Outline
presets.desc: bold white letters, black outline, soft drop shadow (default for most game text)

presets.name: Comic Pop
presets.desc: yellow letters, thick dark outline, hard shadow

presets.name: Pixel Retro
presets.desc: crisp aliased pixels, no smoothing (retro / 8-bit look)

presets.name: Terminal Green
presets.desc: green computer-terminal text, aliased

presets.name: Neon Cyan
presets.desc: almost-white core with a bright cyan edge glow

presets.name: Neon Pink
presets.desc: almost-white core with a hot pink edge glow

presets.name: Gold Royal
presets.desc: gold letters, brown outline, dark shadow (titles, rewards)

presets.name: Silver Metal
presets.desc: cool silver letters with a steel outline

presets.name: Ice Frost
presets.desc: pale icy blue letters, deep blue outline

presets.name: Fire Hot
presets.desc: orange-yellow letters, red outline, dark shadow

presets.name: Candy Pink
presets.desc: pink letters with a thick white outline (cute / casual)

presets.name: Grass Green
presets.desc: fresh green letters, dark green outline

presets.name: Magic Purple
presets.desc: lavender letters, deep purple outline

presets.name: Horror Blood
presets.desc: dark red letters, near-black outline, tight spacing

presets.name: Chalk Board
presets.desc: off-white chalky letters with a thin grey edge

presets.name: Cartoon Shadow
presets.desc: white letters, blue outline, long hard shadow

presets.name: Dark + White Stroke
presets.desc: dark letters with a white outline (readable on any background)

presets.name: Minimal Clean
presets.desc: plain white text with a faint shadow (menus, labels)

presets.name: HUD Score
presets.desc: compact white numbers with a thin black outline (score, timer, lives)

presets.name: Title Giant

presets.name: Dark On Light
presets.desc: dark letters with a light halo, for bright backgrounds

presets.name: Arabic Clean
presets.desc: Arabic-capable font (Parvin), white with dark outline, right-to-left

presets.name: Arabic Gold
presets.desc: Arabic-capable font (Parvin), gold with brown outline, right-to-left
